entities.title: Workflows
entities.summary: The GitHub Actions that test every pull request and deploy each changed game from main.
entities.purpose: Holds the workflows and their scripts: ci.yml validates the .dev diagrams and knowledge files and tests and builds each game a pull request changes; deploy.yml deploys each game a push to main changes, or one or all games by hand; game.yml is the one game's test, build and deploy that both call; migrations.yml is the Database migration check on pull requests. scripts/ lists the changed games (leaving .dev files out), finds the last deployed commit and runs the migration gate.
boundaries: Each game's pipeline, as it applies to that game, is described in that game's .dev/pipeline.json; this record only places the files.
Deploying needs the repository secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN; production database migrations are applied by hand, outside these workflows.
